variable.description: Testing base URL — provided directly, not read from config.py (this Lambda has no knowledge of its own API Gateway invoke URL).

request.description: Returns every cart item saved for guest_id and/or user_id. Each item in the response's data array includes an itemId field (string) identifying it — pass that value as the item_id query param on DELETE /website/cart to remove it.

query.description: conditional, string, 1-100 chars, ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ — required unless user_id is given
conditional, integer as string, 1-20 digits, > 0 — required unless guest_id is given
